description: This Java source file defines an abstract class HL7QueueItem that models a generic HL7 message queue item within the OpenMRS system, including fields for source, data, creation date, and associated getter/setter methods.

classes.name: HL7QueueItem
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a queue item related to HL7 messages, with common fields and methods for HL7 message handling.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the queue item was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the queue item.

methods.name: getHL7Data
methods.description: Retrieves the HL7 message data stored in the queue item.

methods.name: setHL7Data
methods.description: Sets the HL7 message data for the queue item.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Returns the source from which the HL7 message originated.

methods.name: setHL7Source
methods.description: Assigns the source for the HL7 message.

methods.name: getHL7SourceKey
methods.description: Retrieves the key associated with the HL7 source.

methods.name: setHL7SourceKey
methods.description: Sets the source key associated with the HL7 message.
